state_definition: Four coarse observable groups, not learned or validated hidden regimes. Trend sign uses inherited trend60 =60bar close log change / (population sd of60daily log returns floored1e-8 * sqrt60). Negative if trend60<0; exactzero nonnegative. Volatility20 is inherited population sd of20daily log returns; low if <=annual mature rolling5 training median(linear .5 quantile), high otherwise. Annual calibration only; reset at priorDec31, same boundaries for every quarter, method and seed. No choice of state count, sign cutoff, quantile or features from subgroup outcomes. This is a new4cell diagnostic using existing descriptors, not the old R17sixcell partition or R29state90 update trigger.
experiment: Read-only revalidation of the actual incoming R42 saved parameters on mature validation evidence
scope: No neural or scalar fits, no new routing policy, no new forecast history, no future trading outcomes or p values. Preserve all 23 histories and 5754 old evidence files. R18 diagnostic; R19,R23,R25 primary.
subjects: All 1088 original monthly decision x method x state cells. Use only previous_source_cutoff and previous_expiry from the actual original R42 record entering that decision, independently reconstructed from prior formal acceptances and intervening clears. Never search for a cleared older source or resurrect a record. Freeze subjects before revalidation. In-life and expired records kept separate; absent and annual-mismatch records are not assessed.

view_definitions.full_validation: Current archived most recent 13 mature weekly observations, filtered by the inherited signal-time state. Some labels were already mature at source acceptance; explicitly count known and source-validation-overlap weeks.
view_definitions.post_source_validation: Subset of current validation with joint_completed strictly after original formal source acceptance cutoff. Primary novel-evidence view. This is not all history since source: observations that have left current validation are not added.
view_definitions.incremental_validation: Subset of current validation with joint_completed strictly after immediately previous scheduled month-end. Distinguish the newest monthly information from repeated post-source observations.

scoring: Original source offsets and current fitted offsets applied separately to the same archived point-in-time annual logits. Three original seed probabilities are equally averaged before Brier and strict >0.5 direction comparison against annual. Retain original forecast model vintages, including across years in the full window. If current head is unfitted, do not mislabel its zero fallback as a fitted comparator.
evidence_gate: For either parameter on the same selected view: no samples -> no_samples; 1..4 -> insufficient_validation; >=5 requires mean Brier difference below -1e-12 and nondecreasing correct count. A failed Brier check precedes direction_worse, as in original gate. These are diagnostic evidence statuses, not a newly authorized routing rule. Source originally had training support; current training availability and operational expiry/mode remain separately recorded.
comparisons: Retain all old/current pass/reject/insufficient categories. Focus on in-life records cleared because original current candidate reason is brier_not_better or direction_worse, not count shortage or expiry. Do not infer older parameter invalid from newer candidate invalid. No threshold or expiry tuning, no source selection based on revalidation.
summaries: All decision dates, early2021-2023, recent2024-Aug2026 and each2021..2026 year. Four methods, three views, in-life versus expired. Count unique calendar weeks, unique source/week pairs and repeated source/week uses. These counts are not independent sample size. All zero-evidence and absent cells preserved.
verification: Freeze 8 sources/protocol/inputs; verify split maturity and archived seed probabilities, independently reconstruct incoming sources; diagnose; independently reconstruct temporal record state and seed/ensemble loss contributions, evidence classifications, all summaries. At every 68 cutoff poison not-yet-mature labels/probabilities and later heads, require invariant current diagnostics. Check every old hash and unchanged prediction/metric files. Visual inspection before delivery.
limitations: All 272 outcomes already examined. Post-source evidence was unseen at original source selection but is not a new blind holdout for this adaptively proposed experiment. Full-window revalidation reuses selection evidence. Shortage is not failure and pass is not proof of future persistence. No pooled new strategy accuracy, no performance-based expiry extension, no baseline promotion.
preserved_results: Original old-budget R25 recent73/12558.4%; natural20annualR25 71/12556.8%; R39quarterR23 73/12558.4%; R42 R19/R23/R25 recent69/72/71 correct unchanged.
